description.p: Pachi el marciano is a cool 2D platform game inspired by classic games from the 80s. Pachi is a comics character created by Nicolas Radeff.
Pachi came from Mars and crashlanded on our planet because of an accident with his U.F.O.
The goal of the game is to collect all the objects of each level, when this is made, the exit gate to the next stage will appear and you can pass trough.
